venture-os.changelog: Operating desks for physical product businesses selling through retail, wholesale or marketplaces: an optional overlay that records category, channels and operating stage without redoing setup. Cash and deductions desk (order to bank receipt, short-payments classified, dispute and collection drafts, cash forecast). Supply assurance (fit brief, matched quotes, references and trial gate, contract packet, warehouse tests, backup capacity). Private intel bank for your own recommendations with date, fit, conflicts and outcomes. Risk preflight card, including calling a known number before paying changed bank details. Retail desk (readiness pack, account register, reorders) and a creator tracker. New commands: cash, deductions, collections, source, vet supplier, switch supplier, intel, find, outcome, preflight, retail ready, accounts, creators. Payments, disputes and outreach stay drafts you send.

companion.changelog: Warm optional two-path onboarding; import chosen AI threads, notes and spreadsheets with privacy checks and dated decisions/preferences. Home HQ, confirmed playback and gap-only questions. Year goal, confirmed people and a light working agreement. Audit-then-connect services, dump-and-sort, one urgent fast lane and parked big decisions. Monthly state of the home folded into the existing self-review with the shared weekly cap. New commands: import, hq, sort. Existing approval, vault, bill-switch and update safeguards retained.
